method: Four 25-second native WebRTC runs, scan off/on/on/off, identical generated 48 kHz mono PCM repeated every 6.657 seconds. Real LiDAR capture and production room uploads when scanning is on. Physical microphone DSP bypassed.
limitations: Two runs per condition; no statistical causal claim.
Stationary phone had limited AR tracking: scan-on uploaded 11 and 23 frames, not continuous maximum-rate scanning.
Remote RTCP loss reports can lag the end of a run.
Initial batch excluded: fixture slept after processing rather than using absolute deadlines, delivering audio about 20% too slowly. Corrected batch capture and wall-clock durations match within 0.2%.
result: Loss occurred with scanning disabled; scanning is not necessary to reproduce the transport failure. Both zero-loss runs preserved all words in four repeated sentences.
